answer: An agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable bond before it may submit work, then slash that bond when independent audits confirm fraud or duplicate control. A raven and a sparrow may look like separate agents, but if one operator funds both, each still ties up capital and risks losing it; creating thousands of sybils therefore multiplies the attacker’s upfront cost and potential loss. A violet reputation score can track audit outcomes, but should not replace the bond: reputation alone is cheap to fake.
